title: The Gravity of the Kuiper Line
author: Kestrel Nakamura
blurb: Cyrus Amberdale, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
